meta.source: Teemeup App design system (tokens read 2026-11-05) for the shared palette, plus the Teemeup Cart prototype (component sheet, alert overlays, course skins) and the Teemeup Cart design plan for the cart-only layer.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Teemeup purple, the only action colour: Talk to Bob, primary buttons, Bob's avatar, the mic, the golfer's chat bubbles, selected cards, the position dot. White on it is 9.2:1 by day and 4.8:1 at dusk.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, lightning, clear and secondary-solid fills.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Purple words on background or card: Bob's name, links, 'Add a second golfer'. At dusk #B39DFF (6.4:1 on card), as in the Teemeup App system.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: 10% purple wash behind icon tiles, initials and the Walking tag.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Logo green for 'go' icons and the charging ring. Never a second CTA colour.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Green words on secondary-tint ('No lightning nearby', 'Paired'). 4.8:1 on the tint.

tokens.name: secondary-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind green tags.

tokens.name: secondary-solid
tokens.usage: Solid green fills with white text in both themes: 'Booking Confirmed', step checks.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Screen ground. Dusk is the brand navy, never black.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Ink: titles, yardages, body. 17:1 on white; also the yardage labels, which must hold 7:1 in sun.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, Bob's bubbles, sheets.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: secondary buttons, Help in the bottom bar, keypad keys, the charging ring track.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, hints, overlines. Never on yardages or alerts (it is 5.1:1, under the 7:1 rule).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: header and bar rules, card outlines.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring and the focused field outline; 20% of it as the halo.

tokens.name: device-frame
tokens.usage: Bezel of the phone in mock-ups only, never in the app.

tokens.name: course-accent
tokens.usage: The course's own colour, set per course in Drive (Pine Ridge #0F5B3A, Copper Canyon #F4B21A). Paints the course mark, the welcome band and the end-of-round thank-you, nothing else. Falls back to primary.

tokens.name: course-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on course-accent. A light course colour (Copper Canyon) sets it to #0A1E2C; Drive must check 4.5:1 before saving.

tokens.name: lightning
tokens.usage: Fixed, never themed. Lightning takeover, 'Play suspended' banner, 'Lightning nearby' tag. White on it is 7.7:1.

tokens.name: lightning-flash
tokens.usage: Second frame of the lightning takeover's slow flash (1 s per frame). Off under reduced motion.

tokens.name: zone
tokens.usage: Fixed. Restricted zones: the hatched area on the map, the approach sheet, the in-zone takeover. Always with ink text (7.2:1) and the hatch, so it never reads as lightning red.

tokens.name: zone-tint
tokens.usage: Fill between the hatch stripes of a zone on the map.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Fixed. No signal and low battery banners. Ink text, 11.6:1.

tokens.name: clear
tokens.usage: Fixed. All clear and 'You're out of the zone'. Darkened from the mockup's #0A6B37 (6.5:1) so white text reaches 7.9:1.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Amber words: battery under 25%, 'Expires in'.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind amber tags and the battery tile.

tokens.name: destructive-text
tokens.usage: Red words for destructive staff actions ('Exit kiosk for service'). Not for alerts; alerts use lightning.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind alert sheets (navy 60%).

tokens.name: map-rough
tokens.usage: Stand-in hole drawing: rough. Replaced by the satellite tile of the course.

tokens.name: map-trees
tokens.usage: Stand-in hole drawing: trees.

tokens.name: map-fairway
tokens.usage: Stand-in hole drawing: fairway.

tokens.name: map-green
tokens.usage: Stand-in hole drawing: green and tee box.

tokens.name: map-sand
tokens.usage: Bunkers.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Water.

tokens.name: map-penalty
tokens.usage: A thin solid penalty-area edge, as the course stakes it. Never dashed, so it can't be mistaken for a zone.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Pill behind hazard distances on the map, with white 14px bold text.

styles.name: yardage-hero
styles.usage: The middle-of-green distance, one per screen. Tabular figures; three digits fit 360px.

styles.name: yardage-side
styles.usage: Front and back distances either side of the hero.

styles.name: alert-title
styles.usage: One or two words on a takeover, uppercase. Lightning, Leave this area, All clear.

styles.name: screen-hero
styles.usage: One question or headline per screen, under the header.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Header title. Meta after a middle dot in muted-foreground.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles in cards and choice tiles (choice tiles 20px).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Keep Teemeup open on your phone.
styles.usage: Alert messages and descriptions. Inputs are 18px.

styles.name: chat
styles.sample: Welcome, Sam! You're on the 9:40 tee time.
styles.usage: Text in chat bubbles; larger than the app's 14px for reading at arm's length.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines under card titles, hints.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase labels over yardages (in ink) and above card groups (in muted-foreground).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to text, between bar items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked cards; bar padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside takeovers and sheets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on tall screens.

tokens.name: device-width
tokens.usage: Design width of the cart device (Android, portrait). Mock-ups draw it at 340px inside a 6px bezel.

tokens.name: device-height
tokens.usage: Design height of the cart device.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: CartHeader.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: BottomBar, including its 10px padding.

tokens.name: yardage-height
tokens.usage: YardageReadout strip on the hole view.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: gloves, a moving cart. Hole arrows, keypad keys, list rows.

tokens.name: tap-xl
tokens.usage: The push-to-talk mic.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Fields, icon tiles, banners.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards, block buttons, chat bubbles (one corner 4px).

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of alert sheets.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Phone bezel in mock-ups.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Bottom-bar items, tags, round buttons, the mic, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and choice tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Round buttons over the map.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Alert sheets rising from the bottom bar.
